sources.name: p_schoolstaff_s
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~> p_schoolstaff_s

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoolstaff_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parque/p_schoolstaff_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"p_schoolstaff_s",  
  
    /* -------------------- CLEAN STRING "NULL" VALUES -------------------- */  
  
    ReplaceTextNulls =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            Source,  
            "NULL",  
            null,  
            Replacer.ReplaceValue,  
            Table.ColumnNames(Source)  
        ),  
  
    /* -------------------- FIX NUMERIC DEFAULTS SAFELY -------------------- */  
  
    FixNumericDefaults =  
        Table.TransformColumns(  
            ReplaceTextNulls,  
            {  
                {"position_id", each if _ = null then 0 else _, Int64.Type},  
                {"contracted_salary", each if _ = null then 0 else _, Int64.Type},  
                {"employee_type_id", each if _ = null then 0 else _, Int64.Type}  
            }  
        ),  
  
    /* -------------------- FIX KIN RELATIONSHIP -------------------- */  
  
    FixKinRelationship =  
        Table.TransformColumns(  
            FixNumericDefaults,  
            {  
                {"kin_relationship_id", each if _ = 12 then 10 else _, Int64.Type}  
            }  
        ),  
  
    /* -------------------- ADD CONSTANT COLUMN -------------------- */  
  
    AddSchoolStaff =  
        Table.AddColumn(  
            FixKinRelationship,  
            "schoolStaff",  
            each 301220000,  
            Int64.Type  
        ),  
  
    /* -------------------- DUPLICATE COLUMNS -------------------- */  
  
    DuplicateContact =  
        Table.DuplicateColumn(  
            AddSchoolStaff,  
            "contact_no",  
            "contact_no_telephone"  
        ),  
  
    DuplicateID =  
        Table.DuplicateColumn(  
            DuplicateContact,  
            "id_number",  
            "id_number_employee"  
        ),  
  
    DuplicateStartDate =  
        Table.DuplicateColumn(  
            DuplicateID,  
            "start_date",  
            "start_date_import"  
        ),  
  
    /* -------------------- SELECT REQUIRED COLUMNS -------------------- */  
  
    SelectColumns =  
        Table.SelectColumns(  
            DuplicateStartDate,  
            {  
                "alternative_number","city_id","contact_no","contact_no_telephone",  
                "country_of_birth_id","date_of_birth","email","employee_type_id",  
                "first_name","gender","id","id_number","id_number_employee",  
                "is_active","kin_contact_no","kin_email","kin_name",  
                "kin_relationship_id","last_name","middle_name","position_id",  
                "province_id","qualification_type_id","race_type_id","school_id",  
                "schoolStaff","start_date","start_date_import","street_address"  
            }  
        ),  
  
    /* -------------------- RENAME FOR D365 -------------------- */  
  
    RenameColumns =  
        Table.RenameColumns(  
            SelectColumns,  
            {  
                {"alternative_number", "tcbgrow_alternativenumber"},  
                {"city_id", "tcbgrow_importcityid"},  
                {"contact_no", "mobilephone"},  
                {"contact_no_telephone", "telephone1"},  
                {"country_of_birth_id", "tcbgrow_importcountryid"},  
                {"date_of_birth", "birthdate"},  
                {"email", "emailaddress1"},  
                {"employee_type_id", "tcbgrow_employeetype"},  
                {"first_name", "firstname"},  
                {"gender", "gendercode"},  
                {"id", "new_staff_id"},  
                {"id_number", "tcbgrow_idnumber"},  
                {"id_number_employee", "employeeid"},  
                {"is_active", "tcbgrow_staffactive"},  
                {"kin_contact_no", "tcbgrow_nextofkincontactnumber"},  
                {"kin_email", "tcbgrow_nextofkinemail"},  
                {"kin_name", "tcbgrow_nextofkinname"},  
                {"kin_relationship_id", "tcbgrow_nextofkinrelationship"},  
                {"last_name", "lastname"},  
                {"middle_name", "middlename"},  
                {"position_id", "tcbgrow_staffrole"},  
                {"province_id", "tcbgrow_province"},  
                {"qualification_type_id", "cr64f_qualificationimportid"},  
                {"race_type_id", "tcbgrow_race"},  
                {"school_id", "tcbgrow_schoolappid"},  
                {"schoolStaff", "tcbgrow_schoolstaff"},  
                {"start_date", "new_start_date"},  
                {"start_date_import", "tcbgrow_startdate"},  
                {"street_address", "tcbgrow_address1"}  
            }  
        )  
  
in  
    RenameColumns;
